earnings.title: Dollar Tree, Inc. Reports Strong Second Quarter Results
highlights: Comparable store net sales increased 3.7% on top of 6.5% last year
Comparable store net sales growth included a 3.3% increase in average ticket and a 0.4% increase in traffic
Diluted EPS of $2.70, including a $1.31 benefit related to the net impact of tariff refunds
Returned $605 million to shareholders through share repurchases in Q2

quotes.text: What continues to set Dollar Tree apart is our ability to deliver value, convenience, and the excitement of discovery all in one shopping trip.

outlook: Increasing fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to a range of $7.70 to $8.05 including an approximate $0.60 benefit related to the net impact of tariff refunds
Q3 fiscal 2026 outlook of 3% to 4% comparable net sales growth and adjusted EPS of $0.80 to $0.95 including a $0.50 impact related to tariff refund reinvestments
Third quarter diluted EPS is currently expected to be in the range of $0.80 to $0.95 including an approximate $0.50 impact related to tariff refund reinvestments

items.heading: Risks associated with merchandise supply could adversely affect our financial performance.
